baselineClassification.reason: The 26 named leaf failures have native ERR_ASSERTION strictEqual status mismatches and preceding exact DTO/effect or no-match diagnostics; six failed parent groups are aggregates

checks: Enrollment and proof are removed after real manage authorization for all six PATCH commands; exact positive DTOs and persisted row/audit are compared before classifying RED
Six valid missing UUID cases reject with the expected MFA reason before no-match404; RED diagnostics establish only the exact missing body and absence of row/audit
All three status no-op paths require proof and preserve the row timestamp and audit absence
Two team edit/status cases observe a real PostgreSQL row-lock wait before removing proof; a separate no-op case loses manage while an independent read binding remains
Two scoped audit-trigger cases remove only the acting SID proof and prove exactly one trigger execution; fixed denial rolls row, audit and trigger session write back
Ordinary local manager DTOs and audited writes, missing/foreign/inactive404, visible reader403, input400 and audited self-revocation remain covered
The common directed test is byte-identical across baseline and fixed; only tenancy/routes.ts differs in the composed sources
The restricted application connection uses real HTTP sessions, with explicitly synthetic ADMIN factor/proof fixtures; RLS, policy068 and shared helper sources remain unchanged
Selected existing tenancy links/structure/people/http/edit and membership regressions pass on the integrated source
limits: Accepted evidence is isolated to35 directed plus57 regression TAP entries:82 independent cases and10 aggregate groups. Prior feature/support results remain separate evidence, not added totals.
The29 new independent cases cover finite combinations; not every role/resource/command/lock/no-match/audit interleaving is tested.
ADMIN factors and proof are synthetic after real HTTP login; enrollment, recovery and TOTP ceremony are outside this increment.

RED status assertions fail before expected MFA reason and final denial assertions. Only GREEN establishes those later assertions; preceding RED diagnostics establish the exact positive or missing behavior.
Generated updated_at is compared semantically and for actual advancement/no-op stability, not asserted identical across separate writes.
Row-lock and narrow fixture-trigger evidence does not establish universal transaction or network-delivery linearization. Isolation and future SQL trigger changes still require review.
No performance benchmark, whole API, Playwright, Android/iOS device or production acceptance is claimed.
Other tenancy mutators and remaining MFA domains are outside these six PATCH handlers. Mandatory MFA remains a cumulative candidate; no migration, checkpoint or runtime is published by this script.
